title: Zero-Freeness of the Hard-Core Model with Bounded Connective Constant
summary: We study the zero-free regions of the partition function of the hard-core model on finite graphs and their implications for the analyticity of the free energy on infinite lattices. Classically, zero-freeness results have been established up to the tree uniqueness threshold $λ_c(Δ-1)$ determined by the maximum degree $Δ$. However, for many graph classes, such as regular lattices, the connective constant $σ$ provides a more precise measure of structural complexity than the maximum degree.
